item.revised_prompt: The square framing and scale of the central diagram in <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The quadcopter is oriented with its nose toward the top edge of the frame, featuring a true X-frame configuration with a 260 mm opposite-motor span and equal horizontal and vertical spacing. Within the forward nose outline, a single forward-facing camera housing sits flush inside the pod contour; because the camera points horizontally forward, its optical lens face is completely hidden from directly overhead, leaving only its rounded upper casing visible. Both the central pod shell and the four arms feature a satin neutral mid-gray finish that catches soft, even highlights and casts gentle contact shadows onto the plain white background, with all guide marks, red dots, blue lines, and lettering omitted.
